OXIDIZED BITUMEN

PetroBind markets oxidized bitumen, also known as blown bitumen, for buyers that need higher softening points, lower penetration, strong adhesion, thermal stability, and durable weather resistance. Grades are selected by softening point and penetration requirements for roofing, waterproofing, pipe coating, corrosion protection, mastics, adhesives, flooring compounds, sound insulation, and electrical insulation. Each confirmed lot can be supported with COA and PDS values referenced against recognized ASTM and ISO test methods before procurement teams approve the shipment.

GRADES AVAILABLE

19

PACKAGING

25 kg kraft bags, 25 kg PP bags, cartons, meltable bags, jumbo bags, or buyer-specific export packing.

STANDARDS

COA / PDS support with recognized ASTM, ISO, and EN test methods
